criteriaScorecard.name: Mandatory Criterion: Leadership / Emerging Leadership
criteriaScorecard.primaryIssue: Primary award certificate issued to a different person; cracked software used; self-asserted salary without FIRS tax proof; 1000x revenue gap.

criteriaScorecard.name: Optional Criterion 1: Innovation
criteriaScorecard.primaryIssue: Not selected or claimed in application portfolio.

criteriaScorecard.name: Optional Criterion 2: Work Outside Immediate Occupation
criteriaScorecard.primaryIssue: Only 1 document submitted (guidance requires minimum 2). Basic digital marketing/SEO training to NYSC corps members lacks technical depth. Books lack ISBN/distribution records.

criteriaScorecard.name: Optional Criterion 3: Commercial / Technical Impact
criteriaScorecard.primaryIssue: Only 1 document submitted. Copy-pasted telemedicine metrics in AI chatbot table. Contradictory metrics ($1.24M vs N85M; 5k vs 32k users). No audited accounts.

criteriaScorecard.name: Optional Criterion 4: Academic Research
criteriaScorecard.primaryIssue: Not selected or claimed in application portfolio.

topRefusalRisks.rule: Appendix Global Talent Mandatory Filing Requirements

topRefusalRisks.quote: CV: NOT FOUND, Personal Statement: NOT FOUND, 3 Letters: NOT FOUND

topRefusalRisks.title: Structural Criterion Evidence Deficit
topRefusalRisks.rule: Tech Nation Rule: Minimum 2 Distinct Pieces of Evidence Per Criterion
topRefusalRisks.impact: Only 1 document submitted for OC2 and 1 for OC3. Both optional criteria automatically fail the minimum document count rule.
topRefusalRisks.quote: OC2: 1 piece submitted; OC3: 1 piece submitted

topRefusalRisks.impact: Payslips issued by applicant's own company without FIRS tax certificates or personal bank statements carry zero evidentiary weight.
topRefusalRisks.quote: Monthly Gross ₦14,542,435, Net ₦10,200,000 supported only by internal payslips

topRefusalRisks.quote: web hosting and domain registration company... shared hosting, VPS hosting...

panelVotes.summary: Severe evidentiary non-compliance: document count deficit on optional criteria, third-party award misattribution, and unverified salary records.
panelVotes.comments: The applicant has submitted only one document each for OC2 and OC3, immediately failing the minimum threshold. MC is fatally compromised by the IESEG certificate issued to another individual.

panelVotes.summary: FinxHost is a web hosting reseller running cracked WHMCS scripts; BotifyAI appears to be an affiliate marketing script launch, not defensible SaaS.
panelVotes.comments: Running infrastructure on nulled ShayanXtreme software is an immediate disqualifier for a technology leader. The website team page still contains template lorem ipsum text.

panelVotes.summary: International award certificate belongs to another person; EU-Africa recognition poster is unverified on official EU-Startups platform.
panelVotes.comments: The international certificate literally bears another person's name. The EU-Startups 10 Leaders claim has zero presence on eu-startups.com and relies on dubious blog URLs.

panelVotes.summary: Submitting a third-party certificate and female pronoun HR records triggers acute deception risks under Immigration Rules Part 9.7.1.
panelVotes.comments: Submitting another person's award certificate as your own is treated as documentary deception by the Home Office. This application must not be submitted in its present form.

panelVotes.summary: Unanimous non-endorsement. Formal simulated refusal letter issued across Mandatory and both Optional criteria.
panelVotes.comments: Every single criterion relied upon contains fatal evidentiary flaws, uncorroborated superlatives, or direct mathematical contradictions.
